mcq_drop.why: Sangoru/Mungoru fractions are obscure trivia beyond PYQ depth
Adhuvanatantram / industries tax: obscure trivia, no exam asks it

patterns: APPSC asks single-term definitions: Kandachara = military (ya0db8de2f5d), Pradvivaka = judiciary (y7088e4f760e), Meruka = tax on sale/purchase, Ayagars = 12.
Tax-term match items (Navidadere, Maneyanna etc.) appear in Group 1 2023; word roots solve them.
Kakatiya vs Vijayanagara nayankara contrast (Prataparudra II, 75/77 nayakas) is an APPSC-specific AP angle.
App has many 3-4 statement items on Amuktamalyada and governors' powers; the exam shows only direct one-line definitions for this topic.
